from shop.cart import discount, free_shipping, shipping_fee
from shop.checkout import checkout_free_shipping, total


def test_free_shipping_above_fifty():
    assert free_shipping(60) and not free_shipping(50)


def test_checkout_agrees():
    assert checkout_free_shipping(60) is True


def test_shipping_fee():
    assert shipping_fee(10, False) == 5 and shipping_fee(10, True) == 15


def test_member_discount():
    assert discount(200, True) == 20 and discount(200, False) == 0


def test_total():
    assert total([(20, 2), (5, 1)], member=False, express=False) == 45 + 5 + 9
